title: Usuku Lombukiso Wokugcina
intro: Bebizelwe ukukhombisa amandla amakhulu, iqembu labadlali abanekhono bazithola bebhekene neqiniso elingalindelekile elalizoshintsha izimpilo zabo unomphela.
clues: Sasidumile ngobuciko bethu, ochwepheshe bokukhohlisa nobuqili.
Sabizwa ngumbusi ukuba sibhekane nomphikisi owayephethe induku elula.
Lapho sibona iqiniso, sawa phansi ngokuzithoba, simemezela ukukholelwa eNkosini yezwe.
Lo ndlovukazi wasisabisa ngesijeziso esinzima, kodwa asizange sinqikaze.
Sasiphakathi kwabokuqala ukukholelwa esigijimini ngemva kokubona isibonakaliso esicacile.
Sabulawa ngenxa yokholo lwethu, kodwa sizoba ngabokuqala ukungena ePharadesi kanye nabalungileyo.
arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
